tuition.headline: Three ways of asking, three sources, one answer.

methods.finding: The line runs from $489,918 to $1,291,293 — 2.64 times — with 6 years up and 4 down. A straight line through them has an R² of 0.10, and the compound rate swings from -46% to +12% depending only on which year you start counting.

methods.what: Five years of budget against actual spending
methods.source: The district’s budget documents, actual columns
methods.finding: The line missed by +27.0%, +14.3%, +0.4%, −51.5% and −37.8%. Three years over, two under. Not systematically under-provided — unforecastable in both directions.

methods.what: The two halves of the line, separately
methods.source: Private and collaborative tuitions, line by line
methods.finding: Private and collaborative miss by 60% to 300% in opposite directions. Pooled they come to −7.9%, not because they cancel but because they happen to be smaller together.

tuition.conclusion: No rate describes this line. The model holds it flat and prices the range instead, because a range is what is actually known.
